text:
greg: Heads-up: starting v2 feature-flag rollout to prod-us in ~3m. Plan 5% -> 25% with 10m hold. Will watch p95 and upstream 5xx.

deploybot: Rollout scheduled id r-us-233, start 7412345685. Pause if errors > 1% OR p95 > 2x baseline.

anya: Quick FYI  v2 changes connection pooling behavior for streaming backends; could increase concurrent connections for a tiny subset of tenants. We added a guard but watch payment/streaming tenants.

frank: infra alert: tenant-cloudpay is seeing a spike in 502s at 7412345689. Localized but above threshold.

ops-qa: Canary paused automatically at 7412345690 due to 5xx spike.

greg: deploybot  pin tenant-cloudpay and tenant-88 to v1 and fully rollback canary. Also add a quick note to release notes about connection-pool risk.

deploybot: Executing commands:
```
/deploy pause r-us-233
/deploy pin tenant-cloudpay v1
/deploy pin tenant-88 v1
/deploy rollback r-us-233
```
Pins applied and rollback complete at 7412345694.

frank: Root cause initial triage: new pool refactor didn't close idle sockets fast enough under bursty reconnects, upstream NGINX returned 502. Patch in PR #1600 reintroduces a passive-close path.

greg: Plan: cut edge-only hotfix image `edge-v2.1.1-hotfix-1`, deploy to canaries, validate 15m, then resume with smaller increments (5% -> 12% -> 25%) and an extra tenant pinlist step.

ops-qa: After pins and rollback, metrics returned to baseline. Will run targeted smoke tests for tenant-cloudpay.

release-notes-bot: Draft entry: "v2 staging: connection-pool change could cause upstream 502s for some bursty tenants. Hotfix edge-v2.1.1-hotfix-1 will be rolled to canaries; affected tenants pinned to v1 during mitigation."

greg: Thanks everyone. Re-open thread if smoke detects more affected tenants or hotfix fails validation.
